verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow orchestration platform, so branching with conditions and parallel paths that merge is a fair question for it. The docs, however, state it 'isn't a no-code Workflow engine — it is Workflows-as-Code', and nothing in the pack shows a visual or ops-facing way to build branches, filters, or parallel fan-out/fan-in. The Web UI is described only as a place to view and monitor executions, not to author workflows.
